summary: The demo effectively highlights mobile UI detail parity and accessibility features such as drawer dimming and focus restoration. Cursor target landing and state transitions are accurately timed and clear. Trimming dense overlay copy would improve overall readability.

textShown.text: A visitor checking this board from their phone gets the same trustworthy detail a desktop visitor gets — starting with something small: even a long product name breaks cleanly onto the next line, never chopped mid-word, even on a screen this narrow.
There's no mouse to hover with on a phone, so tapping "Details" opens the same information a desktop visitor gets just by hovering.
The detail panels slide up, and everything behind it stops responding to taps while it's open — it's dimmed on purpose, not just for looks.
The Open button stays big enough to tap accurately with a thumb — it never shrinks down to a sliver of text.
After closing the panel, the keyboard cursor lands right back on the Details button — nothing gets lost when you lose it.
